- 每个微批次三次集合通信（前向、反向各一次 BF16 权重全收集，一次 BF1.en: - Each micro-batch has three collective communications (one BF16 weight all-gather each for forward and backward, one BF16 gradient reduce-scatter), each per card (d−1)/d×2N bytes; exposed communication only counts the first all-gather and last reduce-scatter in a step (MegaScale, references/text/megascale.txt lines 238-247), both applied to the word embedding.

- 保存及恢复使用正文一阶模型；5 天预留用于启动、评估与计划性停顿。\n.en: - Save and recovery use the first-order model from the main text; 5 days reserved for startup, evaluation, and planned pauses.

单卡计算时间 = 每卡计算量 /（峰值 × 效率）；每步训练时间 = 单卡计算.en: Per-card compute time = per-card FLOPs / (peak × efficiency); per-step training time = per-card compute + exposed communication + input wait. Save/recovery overhead ratio = c/1800 + λ×900 + λ×120. Total days = 5 + training iterations × per-step training time × (1+overhead ratio)/86400.
